name: previous_day_high_low_breakout_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When NIFTY or BANKNIFTY crosses its prior day's high or low, two simultaneous forces create a burst of directional flow in the first 15-60 seconds: (1) directional futures traders who placed protective stops just beyond PDH/PDL are forced out, fuelling an order-book cascade; (2) option market-makers who sold calls (at PDH resistance) or puts (at PDL support) must delta-hedge by buying/selling the underlying as their strikes go in-the-money, adding systematic buying/selling pressure. At 5-second resolution we can enter on the third consecutive bar closing beyond the level — confirming a genuine break rather than a wick — and capture the first 15-25 NIFTY spot points (7-12 BANKNIFTY option points) of continuation before the cascade exhausts.

indicators.name: pdh
indicators.formula: max(high) of all 5s bars on prior trading date
indicators.purpose: PDH is a FIXED DAILY LEVEL — no scaling by bar frequency. The prior day's high is exactly the same reference point regardless of whether we look at 1-min or 5s bars. Computed by partitioning spot_df on session_date and lagging one day.

indicators.name: pdl
indicators.formula: min(low) of all 5s bars on prior trading date
indicators.purpose: Same rationale as PDH — a daily extreme level, not scaled. Lagged one session from spot_df groupby session_date.

indicators.name: dist_from_pdh_bps
indicators.purpose: Filters overextended breakouts. NIFTY moves ~2-5 bps per 5 seconds; 3+ bps confirms the break isn't a wick, 20+ bps means the move has already run 4+ strong bars and we are chasing. Window is per-bar (no rolling needed).

indicators.name: dist_from_pdl_bps
indicators.purpose: Symmetric to dist_from_pdh_bps for bearish PDL breakdowns. Positive value means we have broken below PDL.

indicators.name: consec_above_pdh
indicators.formula: rolling count of consecutive bars where close > pdh, reset when close <= pdh
indicators.purpose: Lookback=3 bars (15 seconds) because 5-second bars are noisy; a single bar above PDH can be a fleeting wick. Three consecutive closes above PDH (15 seconds of sustained breach) mirrors the original's '2 consecutive 1-minute bars' confirmation but compressed to the 5s context. This prevents entering on spike-and-reverse moves.

indicators.name: consec_below_pdl
indicators.formula: rolling count of consecutive bars where close < pdl, reset when close >= pdl
indicators.purpose: Symmetric to consec_above_pdh for PDL breakdowns.

indicators.name: vol_surge_60
indicators.purpose: 60-bar SMA (5 minutes) as baseline captures the intraday volume rhythm without including early session noise. Original used SMA(20) on 1-min = 20 minutes; we use 5 minutes because we want to detect IMMEDIATE volume acceleration on the breakout bar vs recent pace. Longer window would dilute the spike signal at 5s resolution.

indicators.name: session_vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset each session_date
indicators.purpose: Cumulative measure — no scaling needed. Acts as trend filter: NIFTY above VWAP means institutional net long bias; PDH breakout above VWAP has stronger continuation than a breakout while price is below VWAP (potential VWAP magnetic effect pulling price back down).

conditions: dist_from_pdh_bps >= break_min_bps (3 bps) AND dist_from_pdh_bps <= break_max_bps (20 bps) — clean break, not overextended
consec_above_pdh >= 3 — 15 seconds sustained close above PDH
vol_surge_60 > vol_thresh (1.5) — volume above 5-minute baseline on breakout
vix_close < vix_thresh (22) — calm enough for directional breakout to sustain
buy_ce.confirmation: Third consecutive 5s bar closing above PDH is the entry bar

conditions: dist_from_pdl_bps >= break_min_bps (3 bps) AND dist_from_pdl_bps <= break_max_bps (20 bps)
consec_below_pdl >= 3 — 15 seconds sustained close below PDL
buy_pe.confirmation: Third consecutive 5s bar closing below PDL is the entry bar

exit.stop_rationale: A failed PDH breakout on NIFTY typically sees price retrace 8-12 spot points back inside the range within 15-30 seconds — at delta ~0.5 that is 4-6 option points. Using 4 pts cuts the loss before the full retrace develops; if the cascade was real, NIFTY should NOT drop 8 spot pts back below PDH within seconds of a genuine break.
exit.target_rationale: Successful first-leg PDH/PDL breakouts on NIFTY extend 15-25 spot points in the first 30-60 seconds as stop cascades and delta-hedging compound. 7 option points captures approximately 50% of the lower-bound (15 spot pt) expected continuation at 1:1.75 R:R. Exiting at 7 avoids the mean-reversion pullback that typically follows once the cascade exhausts.

filters.vix_filter: vix < 22 — above 22 breakouts whipsaw as IV expansion distorts short-term follow-through
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:25 IST; avoid first 5 min of session for PDH/PDL setups (pre-open noise)
filters.volume_filter: vol_surge_60 > 1.5 — elevated volume vs 5-min baseline confirms institutional participation in the break
filters.trend_filter: close vs session_vwap as intraday trend proxy
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — PDH/PDL is a structural anchoring level used by every participant class; stop-cascade mechanics persist as long as PDH/PDL remain focal points for order placement

adaptation_notes: Original traded individual Nifty50 stocks on 1-min bars holding 15-60 min. Converted to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index on 5s bars holding 15-90s. Key changes: (1) PDH/PDL are computed from spot_df session_date partitioning — no scaling needed, they remain daily levels. (2) Confirmation reduced from 2×1min bars to 3×5s bars (15 seconds) to match the noise level at 5s resolution. (3) Volume SMA compressed from 20×1min (20 min) to 60×5s (5 min) to detect IMMEDIATE volume acceleration rather than session average. (4) VIX threshold unchanged at 22 — still a regime filter. (5) Stops/targets converted from % of price to option premium points (4/7 pts vs original 0.4%/0.5%). The core mechanism — stop cascade + option delta-hedging pressure at prior day's extremes — is ENHANCED on the index because every option market-maker, futures algo, and benchmark PM watches NIFTY/BANKNIFTY PDH/PDL simultaneously, making the cascade more violent and faster than on individual stocks.
weaknesses: PDH/PDL false breakouts ('fakeouts') are common on NIFTY — 3-bar confirmation reduces but doesn't eliminate them
On inside days (NIFTY range entirely within prior day's range), PDH/PDL may never be tested and the strategy generates zero signals
Volume data for NIFTY index 5s bars may be sparse/derived from futures — vol_surge signal quality depends on data provider
After a strong trending day, the new PDH/PDL is far from current price and breakouts are rare
